## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `xcodebuild ... CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO test` passes.
- [ ] New or changed behavior has tests.
- [ ] I tested relevant display and Dock arrangements when applicable.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog are updated.

## Privacy and platform checks

- [ ] No private macOS APIs were added.
- [ ] No telemetry or network access was added without prior design approval.
- [ ] No credentials, signing files, layout files, or private window metadata are included.
